blueprint_concepts: Angle between the lines of a pair; parallel and perpendicular conditions

concept_use.Angle between two lines: The angle between L and L1 is set equal using tan = |(m1 - m2)/(1 + m1 m2)|, giving m = 11/2 (m = 2 rejected).
concept_use.Angle between the lines of a pair; paral: The acute angle between the lines of the pair is tan theta = 2 sqrt(h^2 - ab)/|a + b| = 1/7, and the pair factorises into the component slopes 3 and 2.

english: Let $L_1$ and $L_2$ be the lines represented by $6x^2-5xy+y^2=0$, where $L_1$ has the greater slope. A line $L$ through the origin, different from $L_2$, is inclined to $L_1$ at the same acute angle at which $L_2$ is inclined to $L_1$. Then the slope of $L$ is ______.
hindi: माना $L_1$ तथा $L_2$, $6x^2-5xy+y^2=0$ द्वारा निरूपित रेखाएँ हैं, जहाँ $L_1$ की प्रवणता अधिक है। मूल बिन्दु से होकर जाने वाली एक रेखा $L$, जो $L_2$ से भिन्न है, $L_1$ से उसी न्यून कोण पर झुकी है जिस कोण पर $L_2$, $L_1$ से झुकी है। तब $L$ की प्रवणता ______ है।
solution_full: $6x^2-5xy+y^2=0$ factors as $(3x-y)(2x-y)=0$, so the lines are $y=3x$ and $y=2x$; $L_1:y=3x$ (greater slope) and $L_2:y=2x$.

The acute angle $\theta$ between them: with $a=6,\ h=-\frac52,\ b=1$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{2\sqrt{h^2-ab}}{|a+b|}=\dfrac{2\sqrt{\frac{25}{4}-6}}{7}=\dfrac17$ (equivalently $\left|\dfrac{3-2}{1+6}\right|=\dfrac17$).
Let $L:y=mx$. The acute angle between $L$ and $L_1$ has $\tan=\left|\dfrac{m-3}{1+3m}\right|$, which must equal $\dfrac17$.
Case $\dfrac{m-3}{1+3m}=-\dfrac17$: $7m-21=-1-3m\Rightarrow m=2$, which is $L_2$ itself and is excluded.

A vertical line through $O$ makes with $L_1$ an angle with $\tan=\dfrac13\neq\dfrac17$, so it does not qualify. Hence the slope of $L$ is $\dfrac{11}{2}=5.5$ ($L$ is the reflection of $L_2$ in $L_1$).
originality_note: New: the line L is defined by an equal-angle condition relative to one line of a pair (it is the mirror image of the other line of the pair), so the angle of the pair feeds the angle-between-lines equation, whose second root is excluded (way 3). Closest known: 'angle between the lines of a pair'. Different because: the angle is used to build a new line, with the spurious root m = 2 to discard.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, line, curve and symbol is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath (and a numerical brute-force check), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Stated 'different from L2' to remove the second root and 'greater slope' to name L1. Changed: No change.
key_step: tan theta = 1/7 from the pair, then solving |(m-3)/(1+3m)| = 1/7 and rejecting m = 2.
justification: Two standard formulas in sequence with a root rejection; routine. Comparable to the routine chains rated 2 (2026-P2-Q17, angle between tangents, L2).
